specials.title: Red Dog Bar & Bistro Piney Creek
specials.description:
APPETIZERS/SALADS
BUFFALO CHICKEN DIP
Made with juicy, tender, shredded chicken and creamy cheese buffalo sauce with a spicy kick, baked until golden and bubbly. Served with pita chips. 14 
ASIAN CRUNCH SALAD W/GINGER LIME DRESSING
Crunchy fresh red and green cabbage, carrots, green onion, cilantro, mint and roasted cashews is the perfect balance of crunchy, savory, and sweet. Topped with a zesty lime & sesame ginger dressing...12 (with option to add a protein)

ENTREES:
AUTHENTIC NEW ORLEANS STYLE GUMBO
Made with a dark rous, vegetables, chicken and Andouille sausage, served over rice with a side of collard greens and bread for dipping...22 (with option to add a protein)
RIBEYE STEAK BOWL
Juicy slices of seasoned, seared Ribeye steak, peppers and onions, served over a bed of rice and black beans, topped with Guacamole, Pico de Gallo, cheese, and a creamy cilantro lime dressing...24
GRILLED FLOUNDER BOWL
Grilled cumin-lime seasoned Flounder on a bed of rice and black beans, topped with Pico de Gallo, cilantro, mango pineapple salsa, and drizzled with creamy Jalapeno cream sauce dressing...25
"BUBBA'S" SHRIMP BOWL
Shrimp grilled in our house-made "Bubba's" sauce (a chipotle, lime, garlic, tomato, BBQ sauce) with black beans and rice, Pico de Gallo, Pineapple mango salsa, cilantro. Topped with Jalapeño Cream sauce...26

DESSERT SPECIAL- COCONUT CREAM CAKE 
Soft, moist cake base soaked with sweet coconut cream and finished with frosting and shredded toasted coconut... 10

LUNCH SPECIAL FRI/SAT/SUN 11-3PM ONLY
REUBEN SANDWICH
Grilled sandwich made with pastrami, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and house Thousand Island dressing between slices of toasted rye bread, served with chips or fries... 15

SHRIMP TACOS
Shrimp grilled in our chipotle "Bubba's" sauce with fresh cabbage, pineapple mango salsa and Pico de Gallo, served on warm tortillas with Jalapeño cream sauce... 16
